behaviors.behavior: CI regenerates the manifest and diffs it against the current commit's FR<->test topology
A manifest with drifted FR<->test topology fails the build (non-zero exit)
source_commit mismatch alone must NOT fail the gate (self-referential provenance field)
the traceability-manifest CI job runs only on push/workflow_dispatch, never pull_request/schedule
the pinned third-party checkout and astral-sh/setup-uv are full-SHA-pinned, never a mutable tag
the real CI job successfully imports and runs the pinned shipwright-compliance collector against a live network checkout
behaviors.reason: needs network access + the real pinned svenroth-ai/shipwright checkout, unavailable in this offline sandbox; validated instead via a stub collector covering the same control-flow branches, per the CI job's own first live push.

surface_verification.justification: CI-only change (.github/workflows/ci.yml + scripts/ci/*): no client/server route, component, or user-facing behavior was touched, so there is no browser/E2E surface to run.
